finding.problem: The new split changes encode()'s output bytes for every input length not divisible by 4 and can yield an empty 4th stream or a shorter 3rd stream (n=5 gives 2/2/1/0 instead of 1/1/1/2), silently breaking anything that depends on stable output or the old stream layout.
